name: Kyougetsu Keishirou
source:
A mighty warrior and the head of the Kyougetsu clan. This clan is famous for its members' ability to bring misfortunes. They have a big distortion and have a phenomenon of "Reverse Wind". "Reverse Wind" means that if one member of the clan brings a misfortune, the other one will die from the misfortune. He lives in a village of the Kyougetsu clan, which cannot be left easily due to the barrier of Mikado, with his sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c34803]Kyougetsu Sakuya[/url]. Also, Keishirou has the highest known distortion level among the strong warriors. [spoiler]But actually, his distortion level is lower than [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Sakagami Habaki[/url]'s.[/spoiler]

He was called to a Fencing Kagura ceremony as a representative of the distorted ones, but in the end [spoiler]was defeated by [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Sakagami Habaki[/url].[/spoiler]

Keishirou had a rather twisted personality. He was chronically irritable. The calmer he looked on the outside, the rougher he was on the inside. Happiness was an agony for him, since it was a bewildering feeling, that was not fitting for him. It could even be called a curse. Still, he loved his sister, though he was not honest with his feelings. [spoiler]While time was passing, his personality was changing and he was becoming more honest and used to his feelings. Also, there was another being that resided in him and gave him powers of distortion, [url=https://vndb.org/c28990]Kaziklu Bey[/url], but in the final battle with [url=https://vndb.org/c34815]Sukuna[/url] he rejected his being and remained himself. In other words, he may be said to have broken his but only his curse at that time. Together with this, he lost his distortion and became one to achieve his goals only with his own strength.

[i]He met his death after defending [url=https://vndb.org/c34803]Sakuya[/url] from the [url=https://vndb.org/c34807]Nakanoin Reizen[/url]'s warriors and releasing her from the curse. As a result, he has made a crack in the World of Tengu.[/i][/spoiler]
